details:
Dear VRChat Team and Users,

Thank you very much for taking the time to read my proposal.

I have been enjoying VRChat since 2021, spending nearly four years experiencing all that this platform has to offer. Over time, I developed an interest in creating my own worlds, leading me to use Unity to design and publish multiple VRChat worlds. Throughout this process, I have connected with many avatar and world creators, sharing knowledge and collaborating to build large-scale content together. These experiences have positively impacted my career and personal relationships, and I attribute much of this to VRChat. Before addressing my concerns, I would first like to express my sincere gratitude to the VRChat team for their dedication and hard work in maintaining and improving this platform.

[The Growing Issue of Avatar Ripping]

Recently, the issue of avatar ripping has become increasingly severe. I am writing this proposal to urge VRChat to implement effective countermeasures that will protect creators' intellectual property and promote a safer environment for avatar creation.

Currently, VRChat allows users to create their own original avatars using 3D models and clothing purchased from platforms such as Booth. This creative process requires significant time and effort from creators, and their intellectual property plays a fundamental role in VRChat’s ecosystem. Encouraging avatar creation not only benefits Booth sellers by increasing sales and encouraging the release of new models, but it also fosters a thriving community where users can exchange techniques and knowledge.

However, some malicious users have been exploiting illegal programs to extract and steal avatars created by others. This ongoing issue demonstrates that VRChat is currently unable to fully protect creators’ intellectual property rights.

These illegal programs can extract the avatar data of every user within an instance with just a single execution. Shockingly, they can even retrieve data from avatars that users have uploaded but are not currently wearing. Worse yet, these programs are being distributed for free on various platforms, including ripper stores, which can be easily accessed through a simple Google search. Some of these sites even host disturbing events where users who extract the most avatars within a given timeframe are rewarded.

This is not just a violation of creative rights—it is also a significant security risk. While avatar data may be the primary target now, in the future, these programs could potentially extract personal user data or even confidential VRChat documentation.

[The Impact on the VRChat Community]

Many VRChat users are now avoiding public instances to prevent their avatars from being ripped. Instead, they limit their interactions to private instances with only close friends. However, concerns have been raised that certain video player assets sold on Booth may allow for data extraction even within private instances. As a result, many users are experiencing heightened anxiety, and some of my acquaintances have already quit VRChat because of these security concerns.

VRChat has a responsibility to protect its users. Failing to address the issue of illegal programs undermines that responsibility. Would you not agree that this is a matter that requires serious attention for the future development of VRChat?

[Suggestions and Requests]

At present, many regular users are suffering due to the actions of those using illegal programs, and this issue is making it difficult for new players to join the community. I strongly urge VRChat to take definitive and effective measures to prevent these problems.

Would it be possible to consider implementing the following solutions?

1. Enhanced Avatar Data Protection – Strengthen security measures to prevent illegal programs from extracting avatar information.

2. Stronger Penalties for Users of Illegal Programs – Increase monitoring and enforcement against users who exploit these programs.

3. Blocking and Legal Action Against Ripper Stores – Investigate possible legal actions to restrict access to these sites.

Thank you for taking the time to read this request. I truly appreciate the VRChat team’s continuous efforts, and I sincerely hope that further actions will be taken to maintain a safe and creator-friendly environment.

Thank you for your attention and support.

Best regards,
title: Request for Measures Against Avatar Ripping in VRChat
